source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Each friendly **KILL TEAM** unit that has this ability gains 3 abilities, each working while the named doctrine is active for it:

- **Furor Tactics** (**devastator doctrine**): its attacks gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- **Malleus Tactics** (**tactical doctrine**): its attacks gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.
- **Purgatus Tactics** (**assault doctrine**): its attacks targeting enemy units up to 9" away from it gain **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**.

Rules for **DEATHWATCH** allies:

- You may include **DEATHWATCH** units even if their Chapter faction keyword differs from the rest of your army, up to 500 points combined.
- Unless a rule says otherwise, you cannot pick a **DEATHWATCH** model as your **WARLORD** when mustering.
- **KILL TEAM** units can take Enhancements only from this detachment.

These are exceptions to the army rules for Space Marine Chapters.
